text: おれの　ポケモン　テクニックで　ひーひー　いわせるぜ！

structure.jp: おれの　ポケモン　テクニックで
ひーひー　いわせるぜ！

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: This verb shape says you make someone do the action. ひーひー いわせる = 'make you say hii-hii', that is, 'make you whimper'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で here shows what is used to get the thing done. テクニックで = 'with technique'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, cocky male speech that pushes the statement at the listener. いわせるぜ = 'I'll make you say it, all right!'.
